visualReferences.name: Supplied Amp reference set
takeaways: Ivory text on dark tinted surfaces
Fine column grid and hairline separators
Sparse lime and orange accent moments
Dense cards and rows with calm negative space
Editorial display scale reserved for brand surfaces
visualReferences.translation: Borrow structure, atmosphere, and restraint. Do not copy Amp branding or move marketing composition into the product dashboard.

display.purpose: Landing, onboarding, empty states, and public shared-plan page titles only.

body.purpose: Primary dashboard, plan list, settings, comments, filters, and all repeated product surfaces.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, CLI snippets, plan fragments, paths, and logs.

shadows.name: ambient-popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, command palettes, status popovers, and temporary overlays.

shadows.name: editor-lift
shadows.purpose: Code blocks, markdown preview surfaces, and editor panels.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, active, selected, and compact feedback transitions.

motion.name: reveal-medium
motion.purpose: Popover and panel reveal transitions using opacity and transform.

rules: Borrow the supplied references for grid, atmosphere, and restraint, not for dashboard composition.
Keep product controls sans, compact, familiar, and keyboard-first.
Use lime for primary action and selected state, orange for conversion only.
Avoid pure black, pure white, gradient text, decorative glass, side-stripe borders, and marketing card grids.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rare high-signal action button for primary task completion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c8ff32; color: #121610; border: 1px solid rgba(200, 255, 50, 0.44); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 650 12.5px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(200, 255, 50, 0.14); filter: brightness(1.03); }

components.name: Plan Panel
components.description: Flat tonal container for plan lists, viewers, comments, and settings regions.
components.css: .ds-plan-panel { background: #082724; color: #eef4e8; border: 1px solid #173d38; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-plan-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 14px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Compact metadata or filter chip that stays quiet until selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #102f2b; color: #879891; border: 1px solid #173d38; border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 650 11.5px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }
